h1: Custom Unisex Shot Glasses for Any Occasion
metaTitle: Custom Unisex Shot Glasses | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom unisex shot glasses in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Perfect for events, bars, and promotions. Fast turnaround.
introHtml: Custom unisex shot glasses are a versatile promotional product that works for any audience, from college bars to corporate events. Unlike gender-specific designs, these glasses feature clean lines and neutral colors that appeal to everyone. Choose from clear glass or durable acrylic, and add your logo with screen printing or etching. Perfect for product launches, happy hours, or trade show giveaways where you want broad appeal.
heroAltText: Custom unisex shot glasses with engraved logo on a bar counter, perfect for promotional events
